title: Syngas biomethanation enrichment
description: Evaluate the impact of temperature on the enrichment of mixed microbial communities for syngas biomethanation in bubble column bioreactors.
samples: 1:1 v/v mixture of anaerobic sludges from the mesophilic mixed anaerobic digester of Valladolid Wastewater Treatment plant (Valladolid, Spain) and the thermophilic anaerobic digester of San Sebastian Urban Waste Treatment Plant (San Sebastian, Spain)
explicit urban setting at sample level
